headline: OpenAI reports large gains on coding evaluations for low-resource programming languages
summary: In an Oct 19 post, OpenAI reports improved results for GPT-6 models on two coding evaluations involving lower-resource languages. On MultiLangBench, which asks models to build a SQLite-compatible database engine across 20 languages, OpenAI reports an average test pass rate of 87.4% for GPT-6 Astra versus 26.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol; GPT-6 Luna scores 40.3% at a stated approximately 78% lower estimated API cost. On a separate COBOL migration evaluation, OpenAI reports 86.6% accuracy for GPT-6.1 Sol at low reasoning effort versus 5.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol, and 97.9% at higher effort. OpenAI released the MultiLangBench setup and test suite. These are company-reported evaluation results, not independently reproduced or evidence of production migration safety.
